data.contenido:
Bɛzoanle anwumabɔvolɛ Geebeleɛle wɔ bɛlɛra kɛnlɛma bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Mɛle la ɛkɛ. Ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ ɔbanrenzɛ yeawo ralɛ nrenya mɔɔ bali belemgbunli dahuu a. Bɛwole adɔma Gyisɛse wɔ mboane tunli nu, na mboaneneavolɛma hɔle ɛkɛ hɔkpɔlale ye. Nzinlii, ɛwɔlɔra bie hilele menli bie mɔɔ vi Aduduleɛ la adenle hɔle adɔma ne anwo ɛkɛ. Yɛnwu ahenle mɔɔ manle bɛnwunle zɔhane ɛwɔlɔra ne nee kɛzi bɛliele Gyisɛse bɛvile mɔdenle biala mɔɔ menli bɔle kɛ bɛku ye la anu la.

Bieko, yɛnwu Gyisɛse, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ 12 la kɛ, ɔ nee ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu kilehilevolɛma ɛlɛtendɛ. Ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ anzi bɛzɔnenle Gyisɛse, na akee ɔbɔle Belemgbunlililɛ nolobɔlɛ nee ngilehilelɛ gyima ne mɔɔ Nyamenle zoanle ye wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo kɛ ɔrayɛ la abo. Amaa yeahola gyima ɛhye yɛ la, Gyisɛse kpale menli 12 na ɔyɛle bɛ ye ɛzoanvolɛma.

Gyisɛse eza yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Ɔvale fɛlɛ ekyi bie nee kpanwo ekyi bie ɔmanle menli apenle apenle lile bɛ ko yile. Ɔyɛle wuleravolɛma ayile na ɔdwazole mɔwuamra bɔbɔ. Awieleɛ kolaa, yɛnwu mɔɔ dole Gyisɛse wɔ ye ngoane mekɛ mɔɔ li awieleɛ la anu amuala nee kɛzi bɛhunle ye la. Gyisɛse vale ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ nsa nee foa a hanle edwɛkɛ ne a, ɛhye ati Foa NSIA ne bo mekɛ mɔɔ ye tendenle le ɛvolɛ 34 la ekyii.

data.titulo: Anwumabɔvolɛ Bie Rale Mɛle Anwo Ɛkɛ
data.contenido:
RAALƐ anwofɛlɛko ɛhye a le Mɛle. Ɔle Yizilayɛnli raalɛ, mɔɔ de Nazalɛte a. Nyamenle ze kɛ ɔle sonla kpalɛ. Ɛhye ati a yezoa ye anwumabɔvolɛ Geebeleɛle kɛ ɔhɔdendɛ ɔhile ye la. Asoo ɛze mɔɔ Geebeleɛle ɛra kɛ ɔbaha yeahile Mɛle la? Maa yɛnlea.

Geebeleɛle zele kɛ: ‘Ɔmɔ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlo wɔ a, ahye o! Gyihova nee wɔ de.’ Mɛle ɛtɛnwunle sonla ɛhye ɛlɛ. Ɔ ti akunlu ɛyɛ ye kesee, ɔluakɛ ɔnze deɛ mɔɔ ye ahyebizalɛ ne kile a. Noko ɛkɛ ne ala Geebeleɛle manle ye ahonle dɔle ye azule nu.

Ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Mɛle, mmasulo. Gyihova ɛlo wɔ kpole. Ɛhye ati a ɔbayɛ nwanwane debie yeamaa wɔ la. Ɔnrɛhyɛ ɛbanrenzɛ wɔawo ralɛ nrenya. Na ɛbavɛlɛ ye Gyisɛse.’

Geebeleɛle hɔle zo hilehilele nuhua kɛ: ‘Kakula ɛhye bayɛ kpole, na bɛavɛlɛ ye Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne Ara. Gyihova bayɛ ye belemgbunli kɛmɔ ɛnee Devidi de la. Noko Gyisɛse bali belemgbunli mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, na ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛnrɛbɔ aze ɛlɛ!’

Mɛle hanle kɛ: ‘Menze nrenya, na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na ɛhye ayɛ ɛkɛ ɛ?’

Geebeleɛle buale kɛ: ‘Nyamenle tumi ne baheda ɛ nwo zo. Ɛhye ati bɛbavɛlɛ kakula ne Nyamenle Ara.’ Akee ɔzele Mɛle kɛ: ‘Kakye wɔ busuanli Ɛlezabɛte. Menli hanle kɛ yenyi somaa kɛ ɔkɛwo mralɛ. Noko ɔnrɛhyɛ ɔbawo ralɛ nrenya. Ɛhye ati se wɔnwu ye, debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛyɛ a.’

Ɛkɛ ne ala Mɛle hanle kɛ: ‘Gyihova sonvolɛ raalɛ a le me! Mɔɔ wɔha la ɛyɛ zɔ ɛmaa me.’ Anwumabɔvolɛ ne akee hɔle.

Mɛle hanle ɔ nwo hɔkpɔlale Ɛlezabɛte. Mɔɔ Ɛlezabɛte dele Mɛle ane la, ɔ ra ne mɔɔ la ɔ kunlu la vale anyelielɛ hanle ɔ nwo. Nyamenle sunsum ne wolole Ɛlezabɛte, na ɔhanle ɔhilele Mɛle kɛ: ‘Bɛyila wɔ kpole wɔ mraalɛ muala avinli.’ Mɛle nee Ɛlezabɛte dɛnlanle kɛyɛ siane nsa, na akee ɔziale ɔhɔle ye sua nu wɔ Nazalɛte.

Ɛnee bɔ zo mɔɔ nrenya bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwosefi la bagya Mɛle a. Na mekɛ mɔɔ Dwosefi nwunle kɛ Mɛle ɛva ɛkolɛ la, ɔzuzule kɛ ɔnle kɛ ɔgya ye. Akee Nyamenle bɔvolɛ ne zele ye kɛ: ‘Mmasulo kɛ ɛkɛva Mɛle ɛkɛyɛ ɛ ye. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle a ɛmaa yenrenzɛ a.’ Ɛhye ati Dwosefi gyale Mɛle, na bɛhendɛle toonwo bɛwole Gyisɛse.Luku 1:26-56; Mateyu 1:18-25. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Bɛwo Gyisɛse Wɔ Mboane Tunli Nu
data.contenido:
ASOO ɛze adɔma ekyi ɛhye sonla holɛ? Ɛhɛe, Gyisɛse ɔ. Bɛwole ye mboane tunli ne anu la ɛtɛkyɛle. Mɛle ɛlɛfa Gyisɛse ado mboane adidi ɛlɛka ne anu, ɛleka mɔɔ nane ne mɔ di aleɛ la. Na duzu ati a Mɛle nee Dwosefi nee nane ne mɔ a wɔ ɛke a? Tɛ ɛke a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwo adɔma a, anzɛɛ ɔle zɔ?

Kyɛkyɛ ɔnle zɔ. Noko edwɛkɛ ɛhye ati a bɛwɔ ɛke a: Wulomu maanle maanle kpanyinli ne, mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Siza Ɔgɛsetɛse la lile mɛla kɛ awie biala ɛzia ɛhɔ sua mɔɔ bɛwole ye zo la azo ɔmaa bɛdia ye. Bɛtelɛhɛm ɛke a bɛwole Dwosefi a. Noko mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee Mɛle bɛdwule ɛkɛ ne la, bɛannyia sua wɔ ɛleka biala. Ɛhye ati ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛbaboka nane ne mɔ anwo wɔ ɛke. Na kenle zɔhane anu ala a Mɛle wole Gyisɛse a! Noko, kɛmɔ ɛkola ɛnwu ye la, ɔte kpɔkɛ.



Wɔnwu mboaneneavolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛba aranlea Gyisɛse la ɔ? Ɛnee bɛwɔ fiene ne azo bɛlɛnea bɛ mboane nɔe ne, na wienyi kɛnlɛma bie dale bɛ nwo zo. Ɛnee anwumabɔvolɛ ɔ! Ɛzulolɛ kpole hanle mboaneneavolɛma ne mɔ. Noko anwumabɔvolɛ ne hanle kɛ: ‘Bɛmmasulo! Melɛ amaneɛ kpalɛ melɛbɛlɛ bɛ. Ɛnɛ kenle ye, bɛwo Kelaese ne mɔɔ le Awulae la wɔ Bɛtelɛhem. Ɔbalie menli ne ngoane! Bɛbanwu kɛ bɛva avuazinli bɛkyekye ɔ nwo na bɛva ye bɛdo mboane adidi ɛlɛka nu.’ Arɛlevilɛ nu ala anwumbɔvolɛma dɔɔnwo rale na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ. Ndɛndɛ ne ala mboaneneavolɛma ne hɔle kɛ bɛkakpondɛ Gyisɛse, na akee bɛnwu ye.

Asoo ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti Gyisɛse le ngakyile la? Asoo ɛze ye sonla holɛ? Kakye kɛ, wɔ buluku ɛhye ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ lumua la anu yɛhanle Nyamenle Ara ne mɔɔ lumua la anwo edwɛkɛ. Ralɛ ɛhye nee Gyihova yɛle gyima wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔ anwuma nee aze yɛɛ debie biala la. Sonla ɛhye a le Gyisɛse!

Ɛhɛe, Gyihova yele ɔ Ra ne ngoane vile anwuma na ɔvale ɔwulale Mɛle akunlu. Ɛkɛ ne ala kakula ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔnyi wɔ ɔ kunlu kɛmɔ ngakula mɔɔ ɛha la nyi wɔ bɛ nli mɔ akunlu la. Noko ɛnee kakula ɛhye le Nyamenle Ara. Awieleɛ kolaa bɛwole Gyisɛse wɔ mboane tunli nu wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm ɛke. Asoo akee ɛnwu deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɛnee anwumabɔvolɛma ne anye ɛlie somaa kɛ bɛka bɛahile menli kɛ bɛwo Gyisɛse la?Luku 2:1-20. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Menli Mɔɔ Ɛwɔlɔra Hilele Bɛ Adenle
data.contenido:
ASOO ɛnwu ɛwɔlɔra ne mɔɔ ɛlɛta mɔɔ menli ɛhye mɔ anu ko ɛlɛtende ɔ sa wɔ zolɛ la ɔ? Bɛnwunle ɛwɔlɔra ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvile Gyɛlusalɛm la. Menli ɛhye mɔ vi Aduduleɛ nehane, na bɛsukoa nwɔlɔra nwo debie. Bɛdie bɛdi kɛ ɛwɔlɔra fofolɛ ɛhye ɛlɛkile bɛ adenle ahɔ awie mɔɔ anwo hyia la ɛkɛ. Mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne dwule Gyɛlusalɛm la, bɛbizale kɛ: ‘Nienwu a yɛkɛnwu Dwuuma belemgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛwo ye la a?’ “Dwuuma” le duma bieko mɔɔ bɛfa bɛfɛlɛ Yizilayɛma a. Menli ne hanle kɛ: ‘Yɛlumua yɛnwunle kakula ne ɛwɔlɔra ne wɔ Aduduleɛ nehane, na yɛra kɛ yɛbazonle ye.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ Hɛlɔdo, mɔɔ le belemgbunli wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, dele ɛhye la ye adwenle zɛkyele. Ɛnee ɔmkpondɛ kɛ belemgbunli fofolɛ bali ɔ gyakɛ anu. Yemɔti Hɛlɔdo vɛlɛle ɛsɔfo mgbanyima ne mɔ na ɔbizale kɛ: ‘Nienwu a ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwo belemgbunli ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ ɔ nwo ɛwɔkɛ la a?’ Bɛbuale ye kɛ: ‘Baebolo ne se wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm.’

Yemɔti Hɛlɔdo vɛlɛle menli ne mɔɔ vi Aduduleɛ nehane la, na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔdɔ alagye bɛkpondɛ kakula ne. Saa bɛnwu ye a, bɛrabɔ me amaneɛ. Mekpondɛ kɛ medame noko mekɔsonle ye bie.’ Noko, ɛnee Hɛlɔdo, kpondɛ kɛ ɔnwu kakula ne na ɔku ye!

Akee ɛwɔlɔra ne lile menli ne anyunlu hɔle Bɛtelɛhɛm hɔgyinlanle ɛleka mɔɔ kakula ne wɔ la anwuma. Mɔɔ menli ne hɔle sua ne anu la, bɛnwunle kakula Gyisɛse nee ɔ nli Mɛle. Bɛhyɛle Gyisɛse ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Na nzinlii Gyihova bɔle menli ne kɔkɔ wɔ ɛlalɛ nu kɛ bɛmmasia bɛkɔ Hɛlɔdo anwo lɔ bieko. Yemɔti bɛvale adenle gyɛne zo bɛziale bɛhɔle bɛ maanle nu.

Mɔɔ Hɛlɔdo nwunle kɛ menli ne mɔɔ vi Aduduleɛ nehane la ɛhɔ sua nu la, ɔvale ɛya kpole. Yemɔti ɔlile mɛla kɛ bɛhu ngakula mrenya mɔɔ ɛli ɛvolɛ nwiɔ nee mɔɔ ɛtɛdwule ɛvolɛ nwiɔ mɔɔ wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm la amuala. Noko Gyihova lumua bɔle Dwosefi kɔkɔ wɔ ɛlalɛ nu, na Dwosefi nee ye abusua ne hɔle Yigyibiti. Nzinlii, mɔɔ Dwosefi nwunle kɛ Hɛlɔdo ɛwu la, ɔvale Mɛle nee Gyisɛse ɔziale ɔrale sua nu wɔ Nazalɛte. Ɛke a le ɛleka mɔɔ Gyisɛse nyinle a.

Nwane a ɛdwenle kɛ ɔmanle zɔhane ɛwɔlɔra fofolɛ ne vindele a? Kakye kɛ, menli ne nwunle ɛwɔlɔra ne la bɛlumua bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm. Ɛnee Seetan Abɔnsam kpondɛ kɛ ɔku Nyamenle Ara ne, na ɛnee ɔze kɛ Gyɛlusalɛm Belemgbunli Hɛlɔdo babɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔku ye. Yemɔti ɔbayɛ kɛ Seetan a manle zɔhane ɛwɔlɔra ne vindele a.Mateyu 2:1-23; Maeka 5:⁠2. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Kakula Gyisɛse Wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua Ne Anu
data.contenido:
NEA kakula ekyi ne mɔɔ nee mgbanyima ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛtendɛ la. Bɛle kilehilevolɛma wɔ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Na kakula ne a le Gyisɛse. Yenyi ekyii. Kɛkala yeli ɛvolɛ 12.

Ɔzinle kilehilevolɛma ne anwo kpole kɛ Gyisɛse lɛ Nyamenle nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ wɔ Baebolo ne anu la anwo nrɛlɛbɛ kpole a. Noko duzu ati a Dwosefi nee Mɛle ɛnle ɛke bie a? Bɛwɔ ni? Maa yɛnlea.

Ɛvolɛ biala Dwosefi fa ye abusua ne kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɔdi ɛvoyia titile ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Akpabɛnwo ne la. Ɔvi Nazalɛte mɔɔ kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la le adenle tendenle. Awie biala ɛnlɛ kale, yɛɛ keteke biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. Ɛnee bɛnle ɛkɛ wɔ zɔhane mekɛ ne anu. Ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo tia, na ɛnee bɛdi kenle kɛyɛ nsa na bɛadwu Gyɛlusalɛm.

Mekɛ ɛhye anu ɛnee Dwosefi abusua ne ɛyɛ kpole. Yemɔti ɛnee Gyisɛse amediema mrenya nee mraalɛ ngakula wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnea bɛ a. Wɔ ɛvolɛ ɛhye anu, ɛnee Dwosefi nee Mɛle nee bɛ mra ne mɔ ɛlɛtia adenle tendenle ne azia ahɔ Nazalɛte. Ɛnee bɛdwenle kɛ Gyisɛse boka menli mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la anwo. Noko mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdiale kenle ko adenle bɛwiele la, bɛannwu Gyisɛse. Bɛkpondɛle ye wɔ bɛ mbusua nee bɛ gɔnwo mɔ avinli, na bɛannwu ye! Yemɔti bɛziale bɛhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛkakpondɛ ye wɔ ɛkɛ.

Awieleɛ kolaa bɛnwunle Gyisɛse kɛ ɔde kilehilevolɛma ne mɔ avinli. Ɛnee ɔlɛtie bɛ na ɔbizebiza bɛ kpuyia. Na kɛzi Gyisɛse ze nrɛlɛbɛ la zinle menli ne kɔsɔɔti anwo. Na Mɛle zele kɛ: ‘Me ra, duzu ati a wɔyɛ yɛ zɛhae ɛ? Nea, me nee ɛ ze yɛvɛ kpalɛ wɔ wɔ ɛkpondɛlɛ nu.’

Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a bɛkpondɛ me ɛ? Bɛnze kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ metɛnla me Ze sua nu ɔ?’

Ɛhɛe, ɛnee Gyisɛse kulo kɛ ɔtɛnla ɛleka mɔɔ ɔkola ɔsukoa Nyamenle anwo debie la. Asoo tɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛte nganeɛ la ɛ? Mɔɔ Gyisɛse hɔle sua nu wɔ Nazalɛte la, ɛnee ɔkɔ ayia ɔkɔsonle dapɛne biala. Ɔluakɛ ɛnee dahuu ɔyɛ ɛnzolɛ ɔtie edwɛkɛ ne la ati, ɔzukoale ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ɔvile Baebolo ne anu. Bɛmaa yɛyɛ kɛ Gyisɛse la na yɛli ye neazo ne anzi.Luku 2:41-52; Mateyu 13:53-56. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA abubule ne mɔɔ ɛlɛdwu aradɛnla nrenya ne ati zo la. Nrenya ne a le Gyisɛse. Yeli ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ 30 kɛkala. Na nrenya ne mɔɔ boka ɔ nwo la a le Dwɔn. Yɛlumua yɛzukoa ɔ nwo debie. Asoo ɛkakye mekɛ mɔɔ Mɛle hɔkpɔlale ye busuanli Ɛlezabɛte, na adɔma ne mɔɔ la Ɛlezabɛte akunlu la vale anyelielɛ wulule la ɔ? Zɔhane adɔma ne mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛwole ye la a le Dwɔn. Na duzu a Dwɔn nee Gyisɛse ɛlɛyɛ ye kɛkala a?

Kɛkala ala a Dwɔn ɛva Gyisɛse ɛwula Azule Dwɔdan ne anu a. Kɛ bɛsɔne sonla la ɛne. Mɔɔ lumua la, bɛfa ye bɛwula nzule bo, na bɛamaa ye zo bieko. Ɔluakɛ ɛhye a le debie mɔɔ Dwɔn yɛ maa menli la ati, bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne. Na duzu ati a Dwɔn ɛzɔne Gyisɛse a?

Dwɔn yɛle ye zɔ ɔluakɛ Gyisɛse rale na ɔzele Dwɔn kɛ ɔzɔne ye la ati ɔ. Dwɔn sɔne menli mɔɔ kpondɛ kɛ bɛnu bɛ nwo wɔ ninyɛne ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛle la anwo la. Noko asoo Gyisɛse yɛle debie ɛtane ɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnu ɔ nwo wɔ nwolɛ ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, Gyisɛse anyɛ zɔ ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle Nyamenle mumua ne Ara mɔɔ vi anwuma a. Yemɔti ɔhanle ɔhilele Dwɔn kɛ ɔzɔne ye wɔ debie gyɛne bie anwo. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ ɛnee zɔhane deɛ ne de la.

Kolaa na Gyisɛse ara Dwɔn anwo wɔ ɛke la ɛnee ɔle kapentanli. Kapentanli a le sonla mɔɔ ɔfa mbaka ɔyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛkponle nee mbia la. Ɛnee Mɛle ɔ hu Dwosefi le kapentanli, na ɔhilehilele Gyisɛse noko ɔmanle ɔrayɛle bie. Noko Gyihova anzoa ɔ Ra ne amba azɛlɛ ye azo kɛ ɔrayɛ kapentanli. Ɛnee ɔlɛ gyima titile ɔmaa ye kɛ ɔyɛ, na ɛnee mekɛ ɛdwu kɛ Gyisɛse bɔ ɔ bo yɛ. Yemɔti amaa yeahile kɛ akee yera kɛ ɔbayɛ ɔ Ze ɛhulolɛdeɛ la, Gyisɛse zele Dwɔn kɛ ɔzɔne ye. Asoo ɛhye sɔ Nyamenle anye ɔ? Ɛhɛe, ɔsɔ ɔ nye, ɔluakɛ, mɔɔ Gyisɛse vi azule ne anu vole file zo la, ɛnelɛ bie vi anwuma zele kɛ: ‘Ɛhye a le me Ra, mɔɔ me nye die ɔ nwo la.’ Eza ɔbayɛ kɛ anwuma bukele na abubule ɛhye dwule rale Gyisɛse anwo zo. Noko tɛ abubule kpalɛ ɔ. Ɔzɔho bie ala. Nyamenle sunsum nwuanzanwuanza ne ɔ.

Kɛkala Gyisɛse lɛ ninyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdwenle nwolɛ a, yemɔti ɔhɔdɛnlanle ɛleka bie mɔɔ ɔle koonwu la kenle 40. Seetan hɔle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne. Seetan bɔle mɔdenle fane nsa kɛ ɔmaa Gyisɛse ayɛ debie mɔɔ ɔtia Nyamenle mɛla la. Noko Gyisɛse anyɛ.

Yemɔ anzi, Gyisɛse ziale hɔle na ɔ nee menli bie mɔɔ lumua rayɛle ye menli mɔɔ li ɔ nzi, anzɛɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma la yiale. Bɛ aluma ne bie mɔ a le Andelu, Pita (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Saemɔn), Felepe yɛɛ Natanayɛle (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Baatɔlomiyu). Gyisɛse nee ɛdoavolɛma fofolɛ ɛhye mɔ hɔle Galeli maanzinli ne anu. Bɛdwule Galeli la bɛhɔle Natanayɛle sua zo mɔɔ yemɔ a le Kana la. Wɔ ɛkɛ ne Gyisɛse hɔle atɔfolɛlielɛ kpole bie abo, na ɔyɛle ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ lumua la. Ɛze deɛ holɛ ko ɔ? Ɔmanle nzule hakyile nwanye.Mateyu 3:13-17; 4:1-11; 13:55; Maake 6:⁠3; Dwɔn 1:29-51; 2:1-12. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Gyisɛse Te Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua Ne Anwo
data.contenido:
ƆZƆHO kɛ Gyisɛse amgba ɛva ɛya wɔ ɛke, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Asoo ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti yeva ɛya kpole la? Kɛmɔ menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la le anyebolo kpole la ati ɔ. Bɛlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛkɛnyia ezukoa dɔɔnwo bɛkɛvi menli mɔɔ ɛra ɛke kɛ bɛbazonle Nyamenle la ɛkɛ.

Asoo ɛnwu nlankɛ mralɛ yɛɛ mboane yɛɛ mɔlɔnoma ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti? Nyɛ, menli ne ɛlɛtɔne nane ɛhye mɔ wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu ɛke. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti bɛlɛyɛ zɔ la ɔ? Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma ne hyia nane nee nloma mɔɔ bɛfa bɛabɔ afɔle bɛamaa Nyamenle la ati ɔ.

Nyamenle mɛla ne hanle kɛ saa Yizilayɛnli yɛ ɛtane a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbɔ nwolɛ afɔle ɔmaa Nyamenle. Na ɛnee mekɛ ne bie, noko, wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛma bɔ afɔle a. Noko ɛnee nienwu a Yizilayɛnli banyia nloma nee nane ava abɔ afɔle amaa Nyamenle a?

Ɛnee Yizilayɛma bie mɔ lɛ nloma nee nane. Yemɔti ɛnee bɛkola bɛbɔ afɔle ɛhye mɔ. Noko ɛnee Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo ɛnlɛ nane anzɛɛ nloma. Na ɛnee bɛ nuhua bie mɔ ɛmbikye Gyɛlusalɛm na ɛnee bɛngola bɛnva bɛ nane ne mɔ anu ko bɛmba ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Yemɔti bɛradɔle nane nee nloma mɔɔ bɛhyiale nwolɛ la wɔ ɛke. Noko ɛnee bolɛ mɔɔ menli ɛhye mɔ die menli ne la yɛ se somaa. Ɛnee bɛlɛsisi menli ne. Ɛye yemɔ ɛsie ahane a, ɔnle kɛ bɛdi gua wɔ Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu wɔ ɛke.

Ɛhye a ɛmaa Gyisɛse ɛva ɛya la. Yemɔti ɔbutubutule menli ne ɛkponle ne mɔ mɔɔ ezukoa ne gua zolɛ la na ɔzandele bɛ ezukoa ne. Eza, ɔvale nyɛma ɔyɛle empele na ɔvale ɔvoanle nane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɔvile ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Ɔzele bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtɔne mɔlɔnoma ne la kɛ: ‘Bɛva bɛ bɛvinde! Bɛmmafa me Ze sua ne bɛyɛ gua nu.’

Ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne bie mɔ boka ɔ nwo wɔ ɛke wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Bɛnwunle mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛlɛyɛ la na ɔzinle bɛ nwo. Akee bɛhakyele kɛ bɛha bɛdo ɛkɛ ne wɔ Baebolo ne anu bɛvane Nyamenle Ara ne anwo kɛ: ‘Nyamenle sua ne anwo ɛhulolɛ sɔ kɛ senle la wɔ ye nu.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛra Gyɛlusalɛm ɛke kɛ ɔbali Akpabɛnwo ne la, ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo. Nzinlii, Gyisɛse vile Dwudiya na ɔbɔle ye adendulɛ ne abo kɛ ɔsia yeahɔ Galeli. Noko ɔkɔ la, ɔvale Samɛlea maanzinli nu. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ zile wɔ ɛkɛ ne la.Dwɔn 2:13-25; 4:3, 4. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Ɔ Nee Raalɛ Ne Wɔ Bula Ne Azo
data.contenido:
GYISƐSE ɛgyinla kɛ ɔdie ye ɛnwomenle wɔ bula bie azo wɔ Samɛlea. Ye ɛdoavolɛma ne ɛhɔ sua zo kadɔ aleɛ. Raalɛ ne mɔɔ Gyisɛse ne ye ɛlɛtendɛ la ɛra kɛ ɔbado bula ne bie. Ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Maa me nzule ne bie meno.’

Ɛhye zinle raalɛ ne anwo kpole. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔzinle ɔ nwo la ɔ? Ɔboalekɛ Gyisɛse le Dwuunli, na raalɛ ne le Samɛleanli la ati ɔ. Na Dwuuma dɔɔnwo ɛngulo Samɛleama edwɛkɛ. Bɛ nee bɛ ɛndendɛ bɔbɔ! Noko ɛnee Gyisɛse kulo menli kɔsɔɔti. Yemɔti ɔzele kɛ: ‘Saa ɛze ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛsɛlɛ wɔ nzule ne la a, anrɛɛ wɔbiza ye wɔmaa yemaa wɔ ngoane nzule.’

Raalɛ ne zele kɛ: ‘Yɛmenle, na ɛnlɛ bokiti, yɛɛ bula ye noko anu kɔ. Na ɛnee nienwu yɛɛ ɛnyia ngoane nzule ne a?’

Gyisɛse hilehilele nuhua kɛ: ‘Saa ɛno bula ɛhye anu nzule ne bie a nzuhɔne bahu wɔ bieko. Noko nzule ne mɔɔ mebava meamaa la kola maa sonla tɛnla aze dahuu.’

Raalɛ ne zele kɛ: ‘Yɛmenle, maa me nzule ɛhye bie! Na nzuhɔne angu me bieko. Na eza meara ɛke kɛ mebaza nzule.’

Ɛnee raalɛ ne dwenle kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛka nzule kpalɛ nwo edwɛkɛ. Noko ɛnee ɔlɛka nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle nee ye belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo la anwo edwɛkɛ. Nɔhalɛ ɛhye le kɛ ngoane nzule la. Ɔkola ɔmaa sonla nyia dahuu ngoane.

Gyisɛse akee hanle hilele raalɛ ne kɛ: ‘Kɔvɛlɛ ɛ hu na ɛ nee ye bɛrɛla.’

Raalɛ ne buale kɛ: ‘Mengya nrenya.’

Gyisɛse buale kɛ: ‘Saa ɛse ɛngya nrenya a ɛnee ɛle nɔhalɛ. Na ɛdawɔ mumua ne wɔhɔ agyalɛ nnu, yɛɛ nrenya ne bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɛ nee ye de kɛkala la tɛ ɛ hu ɔ.’

Ɔzinle raalɛ ne anwo, ɔluakɛ ɛhye kɔsɔɔti le nɔhalɛ. Kɛzi Gyisɛse nwunle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛ? Ɛhɛe, ɔboalekɛ Gyisɛse a le Ahenle ne mɔɔ bɛbɔ ɔ nwo Ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle zoanle ye la, na Nyamenle manle ɔnwunle edwɛkɛ ɛhye. Mekɛ ɛhye anu Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne ziale rale, na ɔyɛle bɛ azibɛnwo kpole kɛ ɔ nee Samɛleanli raalɛ ɛlɛtendɛ la.

Duzu a yɛsukoa yɛfi ɛhye mɔ amuala anu a? Ɔkile kɛ Gyisɛse atiakunlu le kɛnlɛma wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti anwo. Na ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛyɛ zɔ. Ɔnle kɛ yɛdwenle kɛ menli bie ɛnle kpalɛ ɔluakɛ asolo kɛ bɛsi bɛde la ati. Gyisɛse kpondɛ kɛ menli kɔsɔɔti nwu nɔhalɛ ne mɔɔ kɔ dahuu ngoane nu la. Na ɔwɔ kɛ yɛdayɛ noko yɛnyia ɛhulo kɛ yɛkɛboa menli yɛkɛmaa bɛkɛzukoa nɔhalɛ ne.Dwɔn 4:5-43; 17:⁠3. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Gyisɛse Kilehile Wɔ Boka Bie Azo
data.contenido:
NEA kɛ Gyisɛse de ɛke a. Ɔlɛkilehile menli ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔ boka bie azo wɔ Galeli. Menli mɔɔ de bikye ye kpalɛ la a le ye ɛdoavolɛma ne. Yekpa bɛ nuhua 12 kɛ bɛyɛ ye ɛzoanvolɛma. Ɛzoanvolɛma ne le Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma titile. Ɛze bɛ aluma ɔ?

Yɛlɛ Saemɔn Pita nee ɔ diema Andelu wɔ ɛkɛ. Akee yɛlɛ Gyemise nee Dwɔn, noko mɔɔ bɛle mediema a. Bɛfɛlɛ ɛzoanvolɛ ko noko Gyemise yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ bieko Saemɔn. Bɛfɛlɛ ɛzoanvolɛma nwiɔ Dwudase. Ko a le Dwudase Yesekaleɔto yɛɛ bɛfɛlɛ Dwudase ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la noko Tadease. Akee yɛlɛ Felepe nee Natanayɛle (mɔɔ eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Baatɔlomiyu), yɛɛ Mateyu nee Tɔmase.

Mɔɔ Gyisɛse vi Samɛlea rale la anzi, ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔka edwɛkɛ ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ lumua la anu kɛ: ‘Anwuma belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛbikye.’ Ɛze mɔɔ zɔhane belemgbunlililɛ ne de la ɔ? Ɔle Nyamenle arane. Gyisɛse a le zolɛ belemgbunli a. Ɔbali tumi yeavi anwuma na yeava anzondwolɛ yeara azɛlɛ ye azo. Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne bayɛ azɛlɛ ye amuala paladaese kɛnlɛma.

Gyisɛse ɛlɛkilehile menli ne belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo debie wɔ ɛke. Ɔlɛkilehile nuhua kɛ: ‘Bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ a bɛyɛ ye zɛhae. Yɛ Ze mɔɔ wɔ anwuma, wɔ duma nwo ɛde. Wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛrɛla. Bɛyɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛdeɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, kɛmɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ anwuma lɔ la.’ Menli dɔɔnwo fɛlɛ ɛhye ‘Awulae Nzɛlɛlɛ Ne.’ Bie mɔ fɛlɛ ye ‘Yɛ Ze Mɔɔ wɔ Anwuma’ ne. Ɛbahola wɔaha nzɛlɛlɛ ne amuala ɔ? Gyisɛse eza ɛlɛkilehile menli ne kɛzi ɔwɔ kɛ bɛ nee bɛ nwo di la. Ɔse: ‘Mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ kɛ menli yɛ maa bɛ la, bɛdabɛ noko bɛyɛ zɔhane ala bɛmaa bɛ.’ Asoo saa menli nee wɔ di ye wɔ atiakunlukɛnlɛma nu a ɛngulo ɔ? Yemɔti, Gyisɛse ɛlɛka ahile yɛ kɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ nee awie mɔ di ye wɔ atiakunlukɛnlɛma nu. Asoo wɔ paladaese azɛlɛ ne azo mekɛ mɔɔ awie biala ɛlɛyɛ ɛhye la ɔnrɛyɛ kɛnlɛma ɔ?Mateyu tile 5 kɔdwu 7; 10:1-4. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

BƐLƐRA ne mɔɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la ɛli ɛvolɛ 12. Gyisɛse lɛ ɔ sa, na ɔ nli nee ɔ ze gyi ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti bɛ nye ɛlie kpole la ɔ? Maa yɛnlea.

Bɛlɛra ne ɔ ze le sonla titile mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyeeyaelɛse a. Kenle ko ɔ ra raalɛ ne anwo dole ye, na bɛvale ye bɛdole ɛkpa zo. Noko yeande kpɔkɛ. Ɛnee anwodolɛ ne kpole ala a ɔyɛ a. Ɔgyegyele Gyeeyaelɛse nee ɔ ye kpole, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛze kɛ bɛ ra raalɛ kakula ne bawu. Yemɔ a le bɛ ra raalɛ kokye a. Yemɔti Gyeeyaelɛse hɔle kɛ ɔkakpondɛ Gyisɛse. Yede nwanwane gyima mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛlɛyɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyeeyaelɛse nwunle Gyisɛse la, ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo ɛbɔ ɛyia ye. Noko Gyeeyaelɛse wolole menli ne anu na ɔdule ɔdɔle Gyisɛse agyakɛ anu. Ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Me ra raalɛ ne ɛnyia ahomeka fee.’ Ɔbodole ye kɛ: ‘Mesɛlɛ wɔ, bɛla na maa ɔde kpɔkɛ.’ Gyisɛse zele kɛ ɔbahɔ.

Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ la, menli dɔɔnwo ne hyelele zo kpalɛ. Arɛlevilɛ nu ala Gyisɛse gyinlanle. Ɔbizale kɛ: ‘Nwane ɛva ɔ sa ɛha me la?’ Gyisɛse dele wɔ ye nu kɛ tumi vi ye nuhua ɛhɔ, yemɔti ɛnee ɔze kɛ awie ɛva ɔsa ɛha ye. Na nwane ɔ? Raalɛ bie mɔɔ anwo ɛdo ye kpole ɛvolɛ 12 la ɔ. Ɔravale ɔ sa ɔhanle Gyisɛse tɛladeɛ ne, na ɔdele kpɔkɛ!

Ɛhye manle Gyeeyaelɛse ahonle dɔle ye azule nu kpalɛ, ɔluakɛ yehola yenwu kɛzi ɔnyɛ se ɔmmaa Gyisɛse kɛ ɔkɛyɛ awie ayile la. Na ɛbɔfoɔ akee rale. Ɔzele Gyeeyaelɛse kɛ: ‘Ɛ ra raalɛ ne ɛwu, yemɔti mmagyegye Gyisɛse bieko.’ Gyisɛse dele edwɛkɛ ɛhye na ɔzele Gyeeyaelɛse kɛ: ‘Mmasulo, na ɔbade kpɔkɛ.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdwule Gyeeyaelɛse sua nu ɛkɛ ne la ɛnee menli ɛlɛsu aye awolɛ. Na Gyisɛse zele kɛ: ‘Bɛmmasu. Kakula ne ɛtɛwule. Ɔlɛdafe ala.’ Noko bɛzelele Gyisɛse na bɛgolole ɔ nwo, ɔluakɛ bɛze kɛ yewu.

Gyisɛse nee bɛlɛra ne ɔ ze nee ɔ nli yɛɛ ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne anu nsa hɔle sua ne mɔɔ kakula ne la nu la anu. Ɔzɔle ɔ sa na ɔzele kɛ: ‘Dwazo!’ Na ɔdwazole ɔrale ngoane nu, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Na ɔdwazole na ɔdiediale! Ɛhye ati a ɔ nli nee ɔ ze anye ɛlie kpole kpalɛ la.

Tɛ sonla ɛhye a lumua mɔɔ Gyisɛse dwazole ye vile ewule nu a. Nuhua ne mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ Baebolo ne ka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la a le kunlavolɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Neeyen suakpole ne azo la ara nrenya ne. Nzinlii, Gyisɛse eza dwazole Lazalɛse, mɔɔ ɔle Mɛle nee Maata adiema nrenya ne, vile ewule nu. Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse kɛli tumi kɛ Nyamenle belemgbunli la, ɔbadwazo menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛwu la yeara ngoane nu bieko. Asoo yɛ nye ɛnrɛlie nwolɛ ɔ?Luku 8:40-56; 7:11-17; Dwɔn 11:17-44. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

EDWƐKƐ mɔɔ ɛzi la ɛnle kpalɛ fee. Kɛkala ala a bɛhu Dwɔn Sɔnevolɛ ne a. Ɛnee Hɛlɔdease mɔɔ le belemgbunli ne aye ne la ɛngulo Dwɔn edwɛkɛ. Na ɔholale ɔnyianle belemgbunli ne ɔmanle ɔpɛle Dwɔn ati.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse dele edwɛkɛ ɛhye la, ɔlile nyane dɔɔnwo. Ɔ ngomekye ɔhɔle ɛleka bie mɔɔ ɛkɛ ne le koonwu la. Noko menli ne lile ɔ nzi. Mɔɔ Gyisɛse nwunle menli dɔɔnwo ne la, ɔlile bɛ nwo nyane. Yemɔti ɔhanle Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɔhilele bɛ, na ɔyɛle wuleravolɛma mɔɔ wɔ nu la ayile.

Ye nɔsolɛ nu, ye ɛdoavolɛma ne rahanle hilele ye kɛ: ‘Aleɛ asɛɛ ɛdwo, yɛɛ ɛke noko ɛmbikye sua zo. Yemɔti maa menli ne adenle maa bɛhɔ namunamu ne mɔ azo bɛhɔkpondɛ debie bɛli.’

Gyisɛse buale bɛ kɛ: ‘Ɔngyia kɛ bɛkɛhɔ. Bɛdabɛ bɛmaa bɛ debie bɛli.’ Gyisɛse bizale Felepe kɛ: ‘Nienwu a yɛkɛnyia aleɛ yɛkɛdɔ yɛkɛmaa menli ɛwolaa ɛhye a?’

Felepe buale kɛ: ‘Amaa awie biala anyia ekyi bɔbɔ ali la, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛnyia ezukoa dɔɔnwo yɛtɔ aleɛ dɔɔnwo.’ Andelu hanle kɛ: ‘Kakula nrenya ɛhye, mɔɔ zo yɛ aleɛ ne la, lɛ kpanwo mumua nnu yɛɛ fɛlɛ nwiɔ. Na ɛhye ɛnrɛdwu bɛ ɛleka bie.’

Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛmaa menli ne ɛdɛnlɛdɛnla ndile ne azo.’ Akee ɔyɛle Nyamenle mo wɔ aleɛ ne anwo, na ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔbubule nuhua ngyikyi ngyikyi. Akee, ɛdoavolɛma ne vale kpanwo ne nee fɛlɛ ne manle menli ne kɔsɔɔti. Ɛnee mrenya 5,000, yɛɛ mraalɛ nee ngakula apenle apenle dɔɔnwo a wɔ ɛkɛ a. Bɛ muala bɛlile bɛmanle bɛ ko yile. Na mɔɔ ɛdoavolɛma ne sesale ɔ bo zo ne mɔɔ hale la, ɔyile ahɛndɛne 12!

Gyisɛse akee manle ye ɛdoavolɛma ne vole ɛlɛne nu kɛ bɛlua Galeli Nyevile ne azo bɛhɔ. Ye nɔe ne, ahumu kpole bie dule, na azudulɛ ne bɔle tiale ɛlɛne ne. Ɛdoavolɛma ne ahonle dule kpole. Akee, ɔdwule akɔlɛmɔleɛ la, bɛnwunle kɛ awie bie lua azule ne anye ɛlɛba bɛ nwo ɛkɛ. Bɛvale ɛzulolɛ bɛdeɛdeanle nu, ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛnze deɛ mɔɔ bɛnwu ye la.

Gyisɛse zele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛmmasulo. Medame ɔ!’ Noko bɛanlie bɛanli. Yemɔti Pita hanle kɛ: ‘Awulae, saa amgba ɛdawɔ a, ɛnee maa adenle maa medame mendia azule ye anye membɛla ɛ nwo ɛkɛ.’ Gyisɛse buale kɛ: ‘Bɛla!’ Na Pita dwule na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtia azule ne anye! Noko akee ye ahonle dule na ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔnoma, na Gyisɛse zɔle ye nu.

Nzinlii, Gyisɛse manle menli apenle apenle aleɛ bieko. Wɔ mekɛ ɛhye anu ɔvale kpanwo nsuu yɛɛ fɛlɛ ngyikyi nwiɔ. Na eza bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛnyianle dɔɔnwo bɛlile. Asoo kɛzi Gyisɛse nea menli la ɛnyɛ nwanwane? Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbali tumi kɛ Nyamenle belemgbunli la ɔnrɛhyia kɛ yɛkɛdwenle debie biala anwo bieko!Mateyu 14:1-32; 15:29-38; Dwɔn 6:1-21. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA kɛ Gyisɛse de ɛke mɔɔ yeva ɔ sa yedo kakula nrenya ne akɔme ɛ. Ɛkola ɛnwu ye kɛ Gyisɛse kulo ngakula edwɛkɛ amgba. Menli mɔɔ ɛlɛnea la le ye ɛzoanvolɛma. Duzu edwɛkɛ a Gyisɛse ɛlɛka ahile bɛ a? Maa yɛnlea.

Kɛkala a Gyisɛse nee ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne vi adenle tendenle bie mɔɔ bɛdule la ɛra a. Bɛlua adenle ne anu la ɛzoanvolɛma ne zule bɛ nwo kpolera. Yemɔti bɛvi adenle ne bɛrale la Gyisɛse bizale bɛ kɛ: ‘Duzu a bɛzule nwolɛ kpolera wɔ adenle nu a?’ Nɔhalɛ nu, ɛnee Gyisɛse ze mɔɔ bɛzule nwolɛ kpolera la. Noko ɔbizale bɛ ɔnleanle saa ɛzoanvolɛma ne kɛha kɛhile ye a.

Ɛzoanvolɛma ne anye ɔ nloa, ɔluakɛ bɛlua adenle ne anu la ɛnee bɛlɛsu kpolera kɛ bɛ nuhua boni a le kpole wɔ bɛ avinli a. Ɛzoanvolɛma ne bie mɔ kpondɛ kɛ bɛbu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛ nwo hyia tɛla bɛ gɔnwo mɔ. Kɛzi Gyisɛse bahile bɛ kɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ bɛkɛhulo kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kpole ɛ?

Ɔvɛlɛle kakula nrenya ne, na ɔmanle ɔragyinlanle bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne. Akee ɔzele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kɛ: ‘Bɛhakye ɛhye, Kyesɛ bɛkakyi bɛ nyɛleɛ na bɛyɛ kɛ ngakula la, anrɛɛ bɛnrɛnwu Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛlɛ. Mɔɔ le kpole kpalɛ wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anu la a le sonla ne mɔɔ bɛlɛ ɔ nwo aze na ɔyɛ kɛ kakula ɛhye la.’ Asoo ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti Gyisɛse hanle ɛhye la ɔ?

Mɔɔ ɔde a le kɛ ngakula ɛndwenle kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kpole anzɛɛ bɛ nwo kɛhyia kɛdɛla kɛ awie mɔ si de la. Yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ ɛzoanvolɛma ne sukoa kɛ bɛkɛyɛ kɛ ngakula wɔ adenle ɛhye azo na bɛgyakyi kpole mɔɔ bɛyɛ anzɛɛ bɛ nwo mɔɔ ɔkyia la anwo kpolera ɛzulɛ.

Mekɛ gyɛne noko wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse manle bɛnwunle kɛzi ɔkulo ngakula la. Mekɛ ekyi bie anzi menli bie vale ngakula rale Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne. Ɛzoanvolɛma ne bɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛfoa bɛ. Na Gyisɛse hanle hilele ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne kɛ: ‘Bɛgyakyi ngakula ne mɔ bɛmaa bɛrɛla me nwo, bɛmmatua bɛ, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle kɛ ɛhye mɔ zɛhae la yɛɛ Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne le bɛ ɛdeɛ a.’ Akee Gyisɛse manle ngakula ne mɔ zo ngoko ngoko, na ɔyilale bɛ. Asoo ɔnyɛ anyelielɛ kɛ yɛkɛnwu kɛ Gyisɛse kulo ngakula edwɛkɛ?Mateyu 18:1-⁠4; 19:13-15; Maake 9:33-37; 10:13-16. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

KENLE ko Gyisɛse hanle hilele nrenya bie kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkulo ɔ gɔnwo. Nrenya ne bizale Gyisɛse kɛ: ‘Me gɔnwo a le nwane?’ Ɛnee Gyisɛse ze mɔɔ nrenya ɛhye ɛlɛdwenle nwolɛ la. Ɛnee nrenya ne dwenle kɛ menli mɔɔ bɛ nwo nane nee bɛ ɛzonlenlɛ le kɛ ye ɛdeɛ ne la ala a le ɔ gɔnwo mɔ a. Yemɔti maa yɛnlea mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle hilele ye la.

Ɔdwu mekɛ ne bie a Gyisɛse bu ɛrɛlɛ fa kilehile. Ɛhye bie a ɔyɛle a. Ɔbule ɛrɛlɛ ɔvanenle Dwuunli nee Samɛleanli bie anwo. Yɛlumua yɛzukoa kɛ Dwuuma dɔɔnwo ɛngulo Samɛleama edwɛkɛ. Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle la ɛne:

Kenle ko ɛnee Dwuunli bie ɛlɛtolo ahɔ Gyɛleko. Na ɔhɔdɔle nwule avinli. Bɛliele ɔ nwo ezukoa na bɛbolo ye bɛmanle asɛɛ ɔwule bɔkɔɔ.

Nzinlii, ɛsɔfo bie mɔɔ le Dwuunli la vale adenle ne azo. Ɔnwunle nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛbole ye la. Duzu a ɛdwenle kɛ ɔyɛle a? Ɔbule ahane ɔhɔle. Akee awie bieko mɔɔ ɔsonle Nyamenle kpalɛ la vale adenle ne azo. Ɔle Levaenli. Ɔgyinlanle ɔ? Kyɛkyɛ, ɔdaye noko yeangyinla yeamboa nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛbodɛboda ye la. Ɛkola ɛnwu ɛsɔfo ne nee Levaenli ne kɛ bɛlua adenle ne azo bɛlɛkɔ.

Noko nea ahenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛbodɛboda ye la anwo ɛke la. Ɔle Samɛleanli. Na ɔlɛboa Dwuunli ne. Ɔlɛfa ayile yeayɛ ye nganlɛ ne mɔ anyunlu. Akee, ɔvale Dwuunli ne ɔhɔle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔbahola yealie ye ɛnwomenle na yeade kpɔkɛ la.

Mɔɔ Gyisɛse hanle ye edwɛkɛ ne wiele la, ɔbizale nrenya ne mɔɔ bizale ye kpuyia ne la kɛ: ‘Ɛnee menli nsa ye ɛdawɔ ɛnea a boni a yɛle agɔnwolɛ manle nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛbole ye la ɛ? Ɛsɔfo ne, Levaenli ne anzɛɛ Samɛleanli ne ɔ?’

Nrenya ne buale kɛ: ‘Samɛleanli nrenya ne ɔ. Ɔhilele ahunlunyele ɔmanle nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛbole ye la.’

Gyisɛse zele kɛ: ‘Wɔha nɔhalɛ. Yemɔti ɛdawɔ noko kɔ na kɔyɛ zɔhane ala.’

Asoo ɛ nye ɛnlie kɛ Gyisɛse si kilehile la anwo? Saa yɛtie mɔɔ Gyisɛse ka wɔ Baebolo ne anu la a yɛbahola yɛazukoa ninyɛne mɔɔ anwo hyia la dɔɔnwo, ɔnle zɔ ɔ?Luku 10:25-37. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MEKƐ mɔɔ Gyisɛse luolua azɛlɛ ne azo amuala la, ɔyɛle wuleravolɛma ayile. Bɛhanle nwanwane gyima ɛhye mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ wɔ azua nee namunamu mɔɔ bikye la kɔsɔɔti azo. Yemɔti menli vale abuburama nee anyezinlirama nee mumule, yɛɛ menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛnde kpɔkɛ la rale. Na Gyisɛse yɛle bɛ muala ayile.

Dwɔn zɔnenle Gyisɛse la, ɛvolɛ mɔɔ bo nsa la akee ɛkpa nwo. Na Gyisɛse hanle hilele ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne kɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ ɔbahɔ Gyɛlusalɛm, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛbahu ye, na akee yeadwazo yeavi ewule nu la. Kolaa na zɔhane deɛ ne azi la, Gyisɛse hɔle zolɛ yɛle wuleravolɛma ne ayile.

Ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle ko bie ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛkilehile. Ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle ne le kenle mɔɔ Dwuuma ɛngɔ ɛleka anzɛɛ bɛnyɛ gyima a. Raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnwu ye ɛke la ɛnde kpɔkɛ fee. Yekpo kondokondo mɔɔ ɔngola ɔ nwo tenrɛ fee wɔ ɛvolɛ 18 anu. Yemɔti Gyisɛse vale ɔ sa guale ɔ nwo zo, na ɔdenrɛle ɔ nwo fɔɔnwo. Yede kpɔkɛ!

Ɛhye manle ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne vale ɛya. Bɛ nuhua ko zele menli ne kɛ: ‘Yɛlɛ kenle nsia mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa yɛyɛ gyima a. Yemɔti bɛrɛla kenle zɔhane mɔ bɛmaa bɛyɛ bɛ ayile, na bɛgyakyi Ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle ne bɛmaa ɔla ɛkɛ ne!’

Noko Gyisɛse buale kɛ: ‘Bɛmɛ nabalabama. Saa ɔdwu Ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle a bɛ biala sianyi ye asoaso ɔfa ye ɔkɔmaa ye nzule. Na raalɛ ɛhye mɔɔ anwo yɛ anwunvɔne, mɔɔ anwo ɛdo ye ɛvolɛ 18 la, yɛɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛyɛ ye ayile wɔ Ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle a?’ Gyisɛse mualɛ ne manle nabalabama ɛhye mɔ anyunlu guale aze.

Nzinlii Gyisɛse nee ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne doale bɛ adendulɛ ne azo kɛ bɛkɔ Gyɛlusalɛm. Mɔɔ bɛdɛlale Gyɛleko ekyii ala la, anyezinliravolɛma nwiɔ mɔɔ sɛlɛzɛlɛ ezukoa la dele kɛ Gyisɛse ɛlɛpɛ nuhua. Yemɔti bɛdeɛdeanle nuhua kɛ: ‘Gyisɛse, boa yɛ!’

Gyisɛse vɛlɛle anyeziliravolɛma ne, na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ: ‘Duzu a bɛkulo kɛ meyɛ memaa bɛ a?’ Bɛhanle kɛ: ‘Awulae, yɛkulo kɛ ɛbuke yɛ nye.’ Gyisɛse vale ɔ sa hehanle bɛ nye ne mɔ, na ɛkɛ ne ala bɛholale bɛnwunle debie! Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti Gyisɛse yɛle nwanwane ninyɛne mgbole ɛhye mɔ amuala la ɔ? Ɔluakɛ ɔkulo menli na ɔkulo kɛ bɛnyia diedi wɔ ye nu la ati ɔ. Na yɛkola yɛdie yɛdi kɛ saa ɔdi tumi kɛ Belemgbunli a awie biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la anwo ɛnrɛdo ye bieko.Mateyu 15:30, 31; Luku 13:10-17; Mateyu 20:29-34. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MEKƐ mɔɔ Gyisɛse yɛle anyezinliravolɛma nwiɔ ne mɔɔ sɛlɛzɛlɛ ezukoa la ayile wiele la anzi mekɛ ekyi, ɔrale namule ekyi bie mɔɔ bikye Gyɛlusalɛm la azo. Ɔhanle ɔhilele ye ɛdoavolɛma ne anu nwiɔ kɛ: ‘Bɛhɔ namule ne azo na bɛkɛnwu asoaso ralɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Bɛzianyi ye na bɛva ye bɛrɛlɛ me.’

Mɔɔ bɛvale asoaso ne bɛrɛlɛle ye la, Gyisɛse dɛnlanle zolɛ. Akee ɔhanle ɔhɔle Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɔ nyunlu ekyii la. Mɔɔ ɔbikyele suakpole ne la, menli dɔɔnwo vindele rayiale ye adenle. Bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo sesɛle bɛ ndanlɛ wɔ adenle ne anu. Bie mɔ pepɛle arɛlɛ mrɛlakɛ. Bɛvale ɛhye mɔ noko bɛguale adenle ne anu, na bɛdeanle nuhua kɛ: ‘Nyamenle ɛyila belemgbunli ne mɔɔ lua Gyihova duma nu ɛlɛba la!’

Wɔ tete Yizilayɛ ɛnee arelemgbunli fofolɛ tɛnla asoaso ralɛ zo kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm na bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔkile menli ne. Ɛhye a Gyisɛse ɛlɛyɛ la. Na menli ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛda ye ali kɛ bɛkulo kɛ Gyisɛse yɛ bɛ belemgbunli. Noko tɛ menli ne amuala a kulo ye a. Yɛkola yɛnwu ɛhye wɔ mɔɔ zile wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse hɔle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la.

Gyisɛse yɛle menli mɔɔ anye ɛzi yɛɛ menli mɔɔ le abubura la ayile wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Mɔɔ ngakula ne mɔ nwunle ɛhye la, bɛyeyɛle Gyisɛse. Noko ɛhye manle ɛsɔfo ne mɔ vale ɛya, na bɛhanle bɛhilele Gyisɛse kɛ: ‘Ɛte mɔɔ ngakula ne mɔ ɛlɛkeha la?’

Gyisɛse buale kɛ: ‘Ɛhɛe, Mete. Bɛtɛkengale Baebolo ne ɛleka ne mɔɔ se: “Ngakula ndetendete nloa nu a Nyamenle bamaa ayɛlɛyelɛ ara la” ɔ?’ Yemɔti ngakula ne mɔ hɔle zolɛ yele Nyamenle belemgbunli ne ayɛlɛ.

Yɛkpondɛ kɛ yɛyɛ kɛ ngakula zɔhane ne mɔ la, tɛ zɔhane ɔ? Menli bie mɔ babɔ mɔdenle kɛ bɛmaa yɛagyakyi Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ ɛhanlɛ. Noko yɛbahɔ zo yɛaha nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ Gyisɛse bayɛ amaa menli la anwo edwɛkɛ.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la ɛnee ɔnle mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔbɔ ɔ bo ɔdi tumi a. Kenle nzu a mekɛ ɛhye badwu a? Ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛdoavolɛma ne kpondɛ kɛ bɛnwu ye. Yɛbazukoa ɛhye anwo debie wɔ mɔɔ doa zolɛ la anu.Mateyu 21:1-17; Dwɔn 12:12-16. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

GYISƐSE a de Ɔlivi Boka ne azo la. Mrenya nna ne mɔɔ boka ɔ nwo la le ye ɛdoavolɛma. Bɛmɛ a le Andelu nee ɔ diema Pita, yɛɛ Gyemise noko nee ɔ diema Dwɔn. Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la a ɛnwu ye wɔ nehane la. Gyisɛse dɛnlanle asoaso ralɛ ne azo hɔle Gyɛlusalɛm la ye kenle nwiɔ ɛne. Ɛnee ɔle Dwɛkɛ. Kenle ne nwonlomɔ ɛnee Gyisɛse wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Wɔ ɛkɛ ne ɛsɔfo ne mɔ bɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛkye Gyisɛse bɛahu ye. Noko akee bɛzulole kɛ bɛkɛyɛ ɛhye ɔluakɛ menli ne kulo Gyisɛse la ati.

‘Bɛmɛ nwɔlɛ nee nwɔlɛ mralɛ!’ Kɛ Gyisɛse vɛlɛle zɔhane ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne la ɛne. Akee Gyisɛse hanle kɛ Nyamenle bahwe bɛ nzo ɔlua ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la kɔsɔɔti ati. Yemɔ anzi Gyisɛse rale Ɔlivi Boka ne azo, na ɛzoanvolɛma nna ɛhye mɔ bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbizebiza ye edwɛkɛ. Ɛze edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛbiza Gyisɛse la ɔ?

Ɛzoanvolɛma ne ɛlɛbiza ninyɛne mɔɔ fane kenlebie anwo la. Bɛze kɛ Gyisɛse bava ɛtaneyɛlɛ muala ara awieleɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo. Noko bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛnwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛhye kɛzi la. Mekɛ boni a Gyisɛse bara bieko arali tumi kɛ Belemgbunli a?

Ɛnee Gyisɛse ze kɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛnwu ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔbara bieko la. Ɛhye le zɔ ɔluakɛ ɔbadɛnla anwuma, na bɛnrɛhola bɛnrɛnwu ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Yemɔti Gyisɛse hanle ninyɛne mɔɔ basisi wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛdi Belemgbunli wɔ anwuma la bie mɔ anwo edwɛkɛ hilele ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne. Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ bie mɔ a le boni?

Gyisɛse hanle kɛ konle mgbole basisi, menli dɔɔnwo anwo bado bɛ na ɛhɔne ahu bɛ, amumuyɛyɛlɛ bahɔ ɔ nyunlu, yɛɛ azɛlɛkpusulɛ mgbole basisi. Gyisɛse eza hanle kɛ bɛbabɔ edwɛkpa ne mɔɔ fane Nyamenle belemgbunlililɛ ne anwo la nolo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo ɛleka biala. Asoo yɛnwu kɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ ɛlɛsisi wɔ yɛ mekɛ ye azo? Ɛhɛe! Na ɛhye ati yɛkola yɛdie yɛdi kɛ kɛkala Gyisɛse ɛlɛdi tumi wɔ anwuma. Ɔnrɛhyɛ ɔbava ɛtaneyɛlɛ muala yeara awieleɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.Mateyu 21:46; 23:1-39; 24:1-14; Maake 13:3-10. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Wɔ Ekpumgbunli Bie Anu Wɔ Ɛbolɔnsam Ne Azo
data.contenido:
KENLE nwiɔ ɛze ɛhɔ, kɛkala ɔle Kule nɔsolɛ. Gyisɛse nee ye ɛzoanvolɛma 12 ne ɛra ekpumgbunli kpole ɛhye mɔɔ wɔ ɛbolɔnsam ne azo la anu kɛ bɛdi Akpabɛnwo aleɛ ne. Nrenya ne mɔɔ ɛnwu ye kɛ ɔlɛfinde yeahɔ la a le Dwudase Yesekaleɔto. Ɔlɛkɔ yeaha yeahile ɛsɔfo ne mɔ kɛzi bɛ sa bahola aha Gyisɛse la.

Dwudase hɔle bɛ ɛkɛ ne anoma, na ɔbizale bɛ kɛ: ‘Saa meboa bɛ memaa bɛkye Gyisɛse a duzu a bɛkɛva bɛkɛmaa me a?’ Bɛhanle kɛ: ‘Dwɛtɛ fufule abulasa.’ Yemɔti Dwudase ɛlɛkɔ ahɔyia menli ɛhye mɔ amaa yeahola yeali bɛ nyunlu yeahile bɛ Gyisɛse. Asoo zɔhane ɛyɛlɛ ɛnle ɛtane?

Bɛli Akpabɛnwo aleɛ ne bɛwie. Na Gyisɛse akee bɔle aleɛlilɛ titile bie abo. Ɔvale kpanwo ɔmanle ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛlie bɛli, ɔluakɛ ɛhye kile me nwonane ne mɔɔ bɛbava bɛamaa bɛ la.’ Akee ɔvale dwora ne mɔɔ nwanye wɔ nuhua la ɔmanle bɛ na ɔzele kɛ: ‘Bɛnlo, ɔluakɛ ɛhye kile me mogya ne mɔɔ bɛbahwi bɛagua bɛamaa bɛ la.’ Baebolo ne fɛlɛ ɛhye ‘Awulae nɔsolɛ aleɛ ne’ anzɛɛ ‘Awulae aleɛ ne.’

Yizilayɛma lile Akpabɛnwo ne vale hakyele mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle manle anwumabɔvolɛ ‘zenle’ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo wɔ Yigyibiti, na ɔhunle belamunli mralɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yigyibitima azua ne mɔ anu la. Noko kɛkala Gyisɛse kpondɛ kɛ ye ɛdoavolɛma ne kakye ye na eza bɛkakye kɛzi ɔvale ye ngoane ɔdole ɛkɛ ne ɔmanle bɛ la. Ɛhye ati a ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ bɛli aleɛ titile ɛhye ɛvolɛ biala la.

Bɛlile Awulae Nɔsolɛ Aleɛ ne bɛwiele la, Gyisɛse hanle hilele ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne kɛ bɛnyia akɛnrasesebɛ na bɛmaa bɛ diedi ne anu ɛmia. Awieleɛ kolaa ne, bɛdole edwɛne bɛmanle Nyamenle na akee bɛvile ɛkɛ ne. Ɛnee akee aleɛ ɛdwo kpalɛ, wɔannea ɛnee nɔɔzo bulu ne nwiɔ bɔbɔ ɛkpa nwolɛ. Maa yɛnlea ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhɔle la.Mateyu 26:14-30; Luku 22:1-39; Dwɔn tile 13 kɔdwu 17; 1 Kɔlentema 11:20. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MEKƐ mɔɔ Gyisɛse nee ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne vile ekpumgbunli ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛbolɔnsam ne azo la anu la, bɛhɔle Gɛtesɛmani tola ne anu. Bɛra ɛke fane dɔɔnwo. Gyisɛse akee hanle hilele bɛ kɛ bɛzinza na bɛzɛlɛ. Akee ɔhɔle ɔ nyunlu ekyii, na ɔbutule kɛ ɔsɛlɛ.

Nzinlii Gyisɛse ziale rale ɛleka mɔɔ ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne wɔ la. Duzu a ɛdwenle kɛ ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ a? Ɛnee bɛlafe! Gyisɛse hanle hilele bɛ fane nsa kɛ bɛzinza, noko mekɛ biala mɔɔ ɔkɛzia ɔkɛra la ɔnwu bɛ kɛ ɛnee bɛlɛda. Mekɛ mɔɔ li amozi mɔɔ Gyisɛse ziale rale la ɔzele bɛ kɛ: ‘Kɛzi bɛkola bɛda wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye anu ɛ? Mekɛ ɛdwu kɛ bɛye me bɛwula me kpɔvolɛma asa nu.’

Wɔ zɔhane mekɛ ne anu ala bɛdele menli dɔɔnwo ane. Nea! Menli ne dedɛ dadeɛ nee ahoholombaka! Na bɛdedɛ tɛkɛ mɔɔ bamaa bɛanwu aze a. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbikyele ɛkɛ ne la, awie vile menli ne anu vindele na ɔhɔle Gyisɛse anwo ɛkɛ ne. Ɔvole ɔ nloa anwo, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Nrenya ne a le Dwudase Yesekaleɔto! Duzu ati a ɔvole Gyisɛse anloa anwo a?

Gyisɛse bizale ye kɛ: ‘Dwudase, ɛdua me nloa anwo ɛvolɛ zo wɔaye me wɔamaa ɔ?’ Ɛhɛe, bɛ nloa anwo ɛvolɛ ne le sɛkɛlɛneɛ. Ɔmanle menli ne mɔɔ nee Dwudase lua la nwunle kɛ ɛhye a le Gyisɛse, nrenya ne mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ye la. Yemɔti Gyisɛse kpɔvolɛma ne rale bɛ nyunlu na bɛhyele ye. Noko ɛnee Pita ɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛva Gyisɛse bɛnrɛhɔ mgbane mɔɔ ɔngo a. Ɔhwenle ye dadeɛ ne na ɔvale ɔpɛle nrenya ne mɔɔ bikye ye la. Dadeɛ ne anga nrenya ne ati na ɔpɛle ɔ nzo fema ne. Noko Gyisɛse vale ɔ sa hanle nrenya ne anzo ne na ɔyɛle ye ayile.

Gyisɛse zele Pita kɛ: ‘Fa wɔ dadeɛ ne wula ye boa ne anu. Ɛnze kɛ mekola mɛsɛlɛ me Ze moalɛ na ɔmaa anwumabɔvolɛma apenle apenle badie me ngoane ɔ?’ Ɛhɛe, ɔkola ɔyɛ! Noko Gyisɛse anzɛlɛ Nyamenle kɛ ɔzoa anwumabɔvolɛma biala, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔze kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu kɛ ye kpɔvolɛma asa ka ye. Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛvale ye bɛhɔle. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ akee dole Gyisɛse a.Mateyu 26:36-56; Luku 22:39-53; Dwɔn 18:1-12. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA ɛtane ko mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo a! Bɛlɛku Gyisɛse. Bɛva ye bɛhenda baka zo. Bɛva pɛlɛko bɛbobɔ ɔ sa nee ɔ gyakɛ anu. Duzu ati a awie bahulo kɛ ɔkɛyɛ Gyisɛse debie zɛhae a?

Kɛmɔ menli bie mɔ kpɔ Gyisɛse la ati ɔ. Ɛze bɛ menli holɛ ɔ? Bɛ nuhua ko a le anwumabɔvolɛ atisesebɛ Seetan Abɔnsam. Yemɔ a le ahenle mɔɔ manle Adam nee Yive yɛle Gyihova anwo anzosesebɛ a. Na Seetan a le ahenle mɔɔ manle Gyisɛse kpɔvolɛma ne yɛle ɛtane kpole ɛhye a.

Kolaa na bɛava Gyisɛse bɛabɔ baka ne anu wɔ ɛke bɔbɔ la, ye kpɔvolɛma ne hilele ye nyane kpalɛ. Ɛkakye kɛzi bɛhɔle Gɛtesɛmani tola ne anu na bɛhyele ye bɛ nee ye hɔle la? Kpɔvolɛma zɔhane a le nwane mɔ? Bɛmɛ a le ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne mɔ. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ zile bieko la.

Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne hyele Gyisɛse la, ye ɛzoanvolɛma ne nriandile. Bɛgyakyile Gyisɛse angomekye bɛmanle ye kpɔvolɛma ne, ɔluakɛ ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ. Noko ɛzoanvolɛ Pita nee Dwɔn angɔ moa biala. Bɛdoale bɛ kɛ bɛkɛnwu mɔɔ kɛzi Gyisɛse anwo zo la.

Ɛsɔfoma ne vale Gyisɛse hɔle nrenya kpanyinli Anase mɔɔ ɛnee mekɛ bie le ɛsɔfo kpanyinli ne la sua nu. Menli ne angyɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne. Akee bɛvale Gyisɛse bɛhɔle Kayafase mɔɔ le ɛsɔfo kpanyinli ne la sua nu. Ɛnee ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma dɔɔnwo ɛyia ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne.

Bɛlile ye edwɛkɛ wɔ Kayafase sua nu ɛke. Bɛvale menli bɛrale bɛmanle bɛrabɔle adalɛ bɛdole Gyisɛse abo. Ɛzonlenlɛ nu adekilevolɛma ne amuala hanle kɛ: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku Gyisɛse.’ Akee bɛtotole nyɛlɛ ɔ nyunlu, na bɛbole ye.

Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛlɛkɔ zolɛ la, ɛnee Pita wɔ alie nwo nehane. Ɛnee maanle nu yɛ ɛyɛlɛ, yemɔti menli ne huanle senle. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛgyigyi senle ne anwo bɛlɛte la, sonvolɛ raalɛ bie nleanle Pita, na ɔzele kɛ: ‘Ɛnee nrenya ɛhye noko boka Gyisɛse anwo.’

Pita buale kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ, memboka bɛ!’

Menli hanle hilele Pita fane nsa kɛ ɛnee ɔboka Gyisɛse anwo. Noko Pita yele biala anloa kɛ ɔnle nɔhalɛ. Pita hanle ɛhye mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa ne la, Gyisɛse dole ɔ nye nleanle ye. Pita nlunle ɔ nwo kpole wɔ adalɛ ɛhye anwo na ɔvindele ɔhɔzunle.

Wɔ Yalɛ nwonlomɔ mɔɔ sɛnzɛne ne ɛlɛbɔ ɔ bo avinde la, ɛsɔfoma ne vale Gyisɛse hɔle bɛ ayia ɛleka kpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Sanhedelene asalo la, ɛkɛ ne. Wɔ ɛke bɛbɔle kpɔkɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛbayɛ ye la anwo. Bɛvale ye bɛhɔmanle Pɔnteɔse Paelɛte, mɔɔ nea Dwudiya maanzinli ne azo la.

Ɛsɔfoma ne hanle hilele Paelɛte kɛ: ‘Nrenya ɛhye ɛnle sonla kpalɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku ye.’ Mɔɔ Paelɛte bizebizale Gyisɛse edwɛkɛ wiele la, ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Mennwu ɛtane biala mɔɔ nrenya ye ɛyɛ a.’ Akee Paelɛte vale Gyisɛse hɔmanle Hɛlɔdo Antipase. Hɛlɔdo a nea Galeli azo a, noko ɔde Gyɛlusalɛm. Hɛlɔdo noko annwu ɛtane biala mɔɔ Gyisɛse ɛyɛ a, yemɔti ɔziale ɔvale ye ɔhɔmanle Paelɛte.

Ɛnee Paelɛte kpondɛ kɛ ɔgyakyi Gyisɛse. Noko ɛnee Gyisɛse kpɔvolɛma ne kpondɛ kɛ bɛgyakyi pilizanli gyɛne emomu bɛmaa ɔkɔ. Nrenya ɛhye a le Balabase mɔɔ le awule la. Mɔɔ Paelɛte vale Gyisɛse vindele alie nwo la ɛnee akee asɛɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ɛbɔ. Ɔzele menli ne kɛ: ‘Bɛnlea! Bɛ belemgbunli ne!’ Noko ɛsɔfo mgbanyima ne mɔ deɛdeanle nuhua kɛ: ‘Fa ye kɔ! Ku ye! Ku ye!’ Yemɔti Paelɛte gyakyile Balabase, na bɛhɔhunle Gyisɛse.

Bɛbɔle Gyisɛse baka nu Yalɛ ewiazo. Ɛnnwu bɛ wɔ nvoninli ne anu, noko bɛbɔ amumuyɛma nwiɔ baka nu mɔɔ bɛku bɛ a, ko wɔ Gyisɛse fema zo yɛɛ ko noko wɔ ye bɛne zo. Ɔhale ekyii na Gyisɛse awu la, amumuyɛma ne anu ko hanle hilele ye kɛ: ‘Saa ɛkɔ wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anu a kakye me.’ Na Gyisɛse buale kɛ: ‘Mebɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛbaboka me nwo wɔ Paladaese.’

Asoo zɔhane ɛwɔkɛ ne ɛnyɛ nwanwane? Asoo ɛze paladaese ne mɔɔ ɛnee Gyisɛse ɛlɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la? Ɛnee nienwu a paladaese ne mɔɔ Nyamenle yɛle ye mɔlebɛbo ne la wɔ a? Ɛhɛe, ɛnee ɔwɔ azɛlɛ ye azo. Na mekɛ mɔɔ Gyisɛse bali tumi kɛ belemgbunli wɔ anwuma la, ɔbava nrenya ɛhye yeazia yeara ngoane nu yeamaa yeanyia Paladaese fofolɛ ne mɔɔ bara azɛlɛ ye azo la anu anyelielɛ. Asoo ɔnle kɛ yɛ nye die nwolɛ ɔ?Mateyu 26:57-75; 27:1-50; Luku 22:54-71; 23:1-49; Dwɔn 18:12-40; 19:1-30. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia
